card.name: Broken bytes of Greek letters
card.fires_on: The partial byte pieces of a Greek letter, mostly the first or middle byte of a character like eta, omicron or theta. It appears in Greek words and letters quoted in etymologies and old philosophical or religious texts.

modes.label: Greek words in etymologies
modes.description: Partway through a Greek letter inside a quoted Greek word, such as in a dictionary origin note.
